items.title: build.jenesis:build.jenesis.launcher 0.5.3 发布, A bootstrap for executable jars produced by Jenesis. The launcher is shaded into the jar root and runs the bundled application out of the one jars/ store the jar keeps its dependencies in, reading class and resource bytes on demand from the still-open outer jar - nothing is held in memory or extracted to disk. What each path holds is named by application.properties rather than shown by where a jar sits: what classpath names becomes the unnamed module of a single loader, and what modulepath names is resolved into a fresh java.lang.ModuleLayer mapped to that same loader, preserving full modularity. The same machinery serves a module that keeps a dependency private: it declares a layer, requires this module, and asks for it by name, and the dependency is resolved into a layer of its own - read from the same jar, never relocated and never unpacked.

        z-rpc / z-oss / z-schedule / z-msg / z-script / z-ctc / z-util / L3 Agent-AI 7 仓) 的版本权威。
        与 z-boot-dependencies (第三方地板) 分家:抬任何一格兄弟仓版本只需要重发本 pom 一个文件夹,
        不牵动第三方地板。z-boot 自家的 z-boot-*-starter 不在这里 —— 它们只能和 z-boot 同版本,
        所以钉在 z-boot-parent。本文件由 _doc/003_script/gen_fleet_bom.py
        生成 —— 坐标清单取自兄弟仓盘上的 pom,版本逐件对 repo1 复核过,别手改。
